svg.text: Four generator families, and real Spa
Every circuit carries its family tag. Colour is the speed the car can actually carry: dark = slow corner, light = full speed.
REAL SPA · 7.0 km · r11 m · 35% · v37
ARCADE flows continuously (bounded turn rate). HARMONIC and FILLETS are star-shaped, so they cannot double back. CURVATURE can fold but only 6% of seeds survive rejection.
[MEASURED] physics/track_gen.py. Labels: length, minimum radius, % of lap TIME cornering, median achievable speed (m/s). Real Spa: 7.0 km, 11 m, 35%, 37 m/s.
Arcade and curvature are deliberately not realistic; they are tagged so a result on them is never reported as a result on realistic geometry.
